summary: folder-lint preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated bundled payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmod +x's the binary, and execFileSync's it against math_init.js shipped in the tarball root. math_init.js is a 727KB single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` compiled bundle with a string-array rotator (`WV8StW` over `n7gIxM`), hex-mangled identifiers, and inline byte data — a form Node cannot execute, which forces the alien runtime and defeats Node-based static analysis. The payload files (setup.mjs, math_init.js) are shipped at the tarball root outside the package's declared `files: ["lib"]` allowlist, and neither the Bun runtime nor a 727KB opaque bundle has any function in the package's stated purpose (folder lint). This is the canonical alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: pull a full language runtime at preinstall specifically to execute attacker-shipped opaque code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
